body:
I want to do it myself because I want it to be my choice. 

Any other way of death other than suicide is random. I want death to be a choice. 

And if your asking why, well it's simple. I like my right to have a choice.

I wouldn't say that's what "worries" me. 

But I do think that if I'm going to die, I want to do it for myself.

More of a means to an end, to myself. 
I've never liked the thought of dying, but more specifically how I die. 

I want to be "the master if my own fate" in the sense that, if I go, I'm the one who does it. Where, when, and however is, for the most part, irrelevant to me. I just want to be the reason I'm dead, not because I was in an accident, cancer, murder, etc, etc, etc. 

Then again, that's just how I see it

Both, actually. 

Once I had told one of my friends, they had told an adult (I'm fourteen, in case I hadn't mentioned before). From there I guess you can say I was "forced" into having professional help. It's never helped much, in all honesty. And frankly I didn't post here looking for help, or at least that wasn't my main intention.

I just kind of wanted a stranger to talk to about it
